b1-20-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Broken Lift
b1-20-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos phones from his office in Budapest. You tell him about the building you live in, where a breakdown has stopped the lift. Many neighbours depend on it.
b1-20-01.prompt: Tell Carlos which building has the breakdown and what the breakdown affects.
cues: Say which building has the breakdown
b1-20-01.target: Hay una avería en el edificio en el que vivimos. Afecta a un servicio del que dependen muchos vecinos.
b1-20-01.english: There is a breakdown in the building we live in. It affects a service on which many neighbours depend.
b1-20-01.canDo: I can describe problems precisely and explain what they affect.

b1-20-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Why It Got Worse
b1-20-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks you why the breakdown in your office building got worse. Nobody acted in time.
b1-20-02.prompt: Tell Meg what caused the problem to get worse and what was needed afterwards.
b1-20-02.target: El problema se agravó porque no se actuó a tiempo. Por eso fue necesario buscar otra solución.
b1-20-02.english: The problem got worse because action was not taken in time. So it was necessary to look for another solution.
b1-20-02.canDo: I can explain why problems happen and what follows.

b1-20-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Act Now
b1-20-03.scenario: You are Meg. At a neighbours' meeting in Budapest, Carlos asks what you think should be done about the breakdowns.
b1-20-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what is necessary and why.
b1-20-03.target: Es necesario que actuemos a tiempo. Hace falta que prevengamos nuevas averías.
b1-20-03.english: It is necessary that we act in time. We need to prevent new breakdowns.
b1-20-03.canDo: I can discuss what needs to be done about a problem.

b1-20-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Second Option
b1-20-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what you would do at the office if the first solution to the problem did not work.
b1-20-04.prompt: Tell Meg what you would do if the first solution did not work.
cues: Say what you would look for
b1-20-04.target: Buscaría una alternativa si la primera solución no funcionara.
b1-20-04.english: I would look for an alternative if the first solution did not work.

b1-20-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Paulino and the River
b1-20-05.scenario: You are Meg. You read a retelling of a story by Horacio Quiroga for a class in Budapest. Carlos asks what happens in it.
b1-20-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what happens to Paulino and where he wants to go.
cues: Say where he wants to go
b1-20-05.target: Una serpiente muerde a Paulino. Él sube a su canoa para llegar a Tacurú-Pucú, pero no llega.
b1-20-05.english: A snake bites Paulino. He gets into his canoe to reach Tacurú-Pucú, but he does not arrive.
b1-20-05.canDo: I can discuss a problem from diagnosis to solution.

b1-20-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Choosing a Solution
b1-20-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. At your office in Budapest you have to explain a problem to Meg, who is visiting. The problem got worse because nobody acted, and you want to propose a plan.
b1-20-consolidation.prompt: Say what happened, why, and what is necessary now.
cues: Say what happened to the problem
b1-20-consolidation.target: El problema se agravó porque no se actuó a tiempo. Es necesario que abordemos su causa.
b1-20-consolidation.english: The problem got worse because action was not taken in time. It is necessary that we address its cause.
